item.title: Mehime no Toriko ~Haikousha no Seifuku Shoujo~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gage
  • 発売日: 2006-10-27
  • スコア: 6.36/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 牝姫の虜 ～廃校舎の制服少女～
  • 英語名: Mehime no Toriko Haikousha no Seifuku Shoujo

あらすじ

You play as an only child who has lost his parents as well as his grandparents. To make things worse he just got transferred to a new school. He at least makes a friend fairly quickly, but there’s something quite dubious about this school. From the classmates to the faculty, they all seem to be in some larger sex scandal. And now our main character is invited to join in the fun.

あらすじ

Kenji Asama has returned to his home city to exact revenge on Douzan Kanzaki, his hated father. And all the girls somehow involved with Douzan will become the instrument of Kenji’s revenge, willing or not…
